lead.headline: TeraWulf's $19B Anthropic Deal Signals AI-Compute Pivot
lead.tldr: The convergence of high-performance computing and energy infrastructure is accelerating, as evidenced by TeraWulf's massive lease agreement with Anthropic.

intro: Dear Founders, Investors, and Friends, here is what moved in Web3 over the last 24 hours and why it matters for the quarter ahead.

top_signals.title: Ripple secures full MiCA license for crypto services across Europe30m
top_signals.summary: Ripple has successfully secured a full MiCA license, allowing it to provide crypto services across the European Union. This regulatory milestone enables the company to expand its operational footprint and offer compliant services in a major global market.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Ripple's MiCA license provides a blueprint for non-EU entities to scale compliant operations across the single market.

top_signals.title: TeraWulf signs 20-year data center lease with Anthropic expected to generate $19 billion in revenue
top_signals.summary: TeraWulf has entered into a 20-year data center lease agreement with AI company Anthropic. The deal involves the Justified Data site in Kentucky and is projected to generate $19 billion in revenue.
top_signals.why_it_matters: This deal validates the transition of Bitcoin miners into diversified AI compute providers to capture higher-margin long-term revenue.

top_signals.title: US Bitcoin reserve hits snag as federal agencies debate for control: Bloomberg12m, US Bitcoin reserve hits snag as federal agencies debate for control: BloombergThe report follows comments from White House crypto adviser Patrick Witt in May, who said the administration was examining the legal implications of creating a Bitcoin reserve.
top_signals.summary: The proposal for a US Bitcoin reserve is facing delays as various federal agencies debate which entity should maintain control. The White House is currently examining the legal implications of establishing such a reserve.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Inter-agency friction in the US suggests that a strategic Bitcoin reserve remains a political ambition rather than an imminent policy reality.

top_signals.title: BonkDAO Reports $20M Theft from ‘Malicious Governance Proposal’
top_signals.summary: BonkDAO suffered a $20 million theft executed through a malicious governance proposal. The attack led to a roughly 7% decline in the price of the BONK token.
top_signals.why_it_matters: The BonkDAO exploit highlights the systemic risk of governance-based attacks in meme-coin ecosystems with low voter scrutiny.

top_signals.title: BonkDAO loses $20 million following 'malicious governance proposal' attack
top_signals.summary: BonkDAO suffered a $20 million loss resulting from a malicious governance proposal attack. The stolen funds were traced to exchanges, prompting Upbit to suspend BONK deposits and withdrawals.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Exchange reactions to the BonkDAO theft underscore the continued reliance on centralized intermediaries for emergency fund recovery.

deals.summary: M1X Global has raised $5.5 million in a seed round led by Paradigm to expand its tokenized sovereign debt platform. The company previously collaborated with the Republic of the Marshall Islands to issue the onchain sovereign bond USDM1.

on_the_radar.title: UN agency moves Stellar blockchain payment initiative beyond pilot stage19m
on_the_radar.summary: A United Nations agency is transitioning its blockchain-based payment initiative using the Stellar network from a pilot phase to full implementation. This move aims to streamline the delivery of humanitarian aid and financial services.

on_the_radar.title: Vitalik Buterin proposes ‘Extremely Lean’ Ethereum, shrinking the chain to near-zero state with ZK proofs
on_the_radar.summary: Vitalik Buterin has proposed a strategy to create an 'Extremely Lean' Ethereum by reducing the chain's state to near-zero. The plan involves shifting state management to validators and utilizing Zero-Knowledge (ZK) proofs for balance updates.

on_the_radar.title: Stablecoin transaction volume hits record $1.79T in June15m
on_the_radar.summary: Stablecoin transaction volume reached a record high of $1.79 trillion in June. This surge indicates increased liquidity and utility within the digital asset ecosystem.

on_the_radar.title: Grayscale says Strategy's recent bitcoin sales should restore confidence in its financing structure
on_the_radar.summary: Grayscale suggests that MicroStrategy's recent sales of Bitcoin will improve the company's financing structure. This move is expected to help the broader Bitcoin market establish a more durable price floor.

on_the_radar.title: Judge revives fraud claim against Barry Silbert, DCG in Genesis Yield lawsuit
on_the_radar.summary: A judge has revived a fraud claim against Barry Silbert and Digital Currency Group (DCG) in a class action lawsuit regarding the Genesis Yield program. The lawsuit focuses on the lending program that allowed customers to deposit cryptocurrency for interest payments.

on_the_radar.title: Bitmine Announces $74M Ether Buys as Chair Says ‘Greater Chances of Clarity Act Passage’
on_the_radar.summary: Bitmine has announced the purchase of $74M worth of Ether, increasing its total holdings. The move is driven by Chair Tom Lee's optimism regarding the potential passage of the Digital Asset Market Clarity Act in the US.

on_the_radar.title: Strategy sheds $216 million in Bitcoin in crypto hoarder’s largest sale ever
on_the_radar.summary: A major Bitcoin holder has sold $216 million worth of BTC, marking the largest sale in the entity's history. This move signals a reversal of their previous hoarding strategy in response to a broader market downturn.

on_the_radar.title: President Trump says he's a 'big crypto guy,' while distancing himself from family's crypto ventures
on_the_radar.summary: President Trump reaffirmed his support for cryptocurrency, describing it as 'powerful' during a launch event for children's investment accounts. However, he simultaneously distanced himself from his family's specific crypto ventures.

linkedin_post: I keep coming back to the TeraWulf and Anthropic deal. A 20-year lease projected to generate $19 billion in revenue is not a typical crypto infrastructure play; it is a massive bet on the physical layer of AI. For years, the market has debated whether Bitcoin miners can actually pivot to HPC, but the scale of this agreement suggests that energy arbitrage is now the primary value driver. When you see a company like TeraWulf leverage its Kentucky site for a deal of this magnitude, it shifts the conversation from speculative mining to becoming a critical utility for LLM training. I'd watch how other energy-heavy miners attempt to replicate this model, as the moat is no longer the hashing power, but the power purchase agreement and the physical data center footprint.
